context_map.exchanged_information: Validated and validation-failed telemetry samples with device timestamp and validation status; failed samples still flow, flagged, never dropped.
context_map.boundary_protection: Reordering treats validation status as opaque and never re-applies Sensor Metric Boundary rules; intake never exposes boundary definitions or ingress-handling internals. Eventual consistency.

context_map.exchanged_information: Ordered telemetry windows and backfill detections to be retained as appended revisions.
context_map.boundary_protection: Ledger translates ordering outcomes into Event Revisions and never mutates stored records or makes ordering decisions; window buffer internals do not leak. Eventual consistency. Open question: ownership of the 60s window versus late-backfill revisions (possible merge if atomicity is required).

context_map.exchanged_information: Revision-appended notifications and auditable raw telemetry history for other platform subdomains.
context_map.boundary_protection: Stable versioned contract of revisions; consumers cannot alter stored history. Open question: external consumer identities (athlete/activity, analytics) belong to other subdomains.
Devices dictate packet format; intake accepts under backpressure and does not leak device-specific formats downstream beyond the Telemetry Sample concept.

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Ingest, validate, order and retain telemetry from a device packet
cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Validation is immediate within intake; ordering and retention are eventually consistent. Samples may be temporarily unordered up to the 60s reorder window. Invalid samples are flagged, never lost; failure at reordering or ledger must not discard samples (retry/hold).

cross_boundary_flows.business_process: Late backfill correction of earlier telemetry
cross_boundary_flows.consistency_expectation: Eventual: ledger appends a new Event Revision; earlier records stay unchanged, so history is briefly without the correction. Open question on 60s window vs revision ownership.
cross_boundary_flows.notes: Samples delayed beyond the window are not specified by discovery.
